title: 오리고 붙이는 분자 모형
author: 김영학
contentHtml:
오리고 붙이는 분자 모형
김영학 2010-09-30

 

9/24(금) 수업 참관


 

Today, the activity is to make compound model by using stickers.

Students use the hole puncher to make circles.
They can find the compound information by using the laptop computers.
This activity is very hands-on and helps them to memorize and understand the groups very well.


 

The result of the activities is very colorful and visual.


 

<Ideas>


 

- Molecules have different sizes. Give the different circle sizes.


 

- Write the each periodic elemental symbol on each circle.


 

- Your Key section needs to be more detailed.


 

- When I visited one school, there was a exhibition board which shows students activity results. It uses sticker to show electrons.

 


 

- I found an interesting thing. There are some differences to explain the connections between molecules.
One student expresses the molecule connections by drawing one line for single bond or two lines for double bonds. Another student expresses single bond by placing circles side by side and double bond with overlapping circles.


 

Students need to explain how to express the bonds on the "Your Key"


 
 

Q) To prepare the experiment, you have to do many things. Do you have lab assistant?

 

A) A student teacher helps him to prepare the lab.
